plan_item: UX-REF-AVID.6 / accessibility, reduced-motion and public/editor parity
plan_status: OPEN; this release closes only the stale-scroll-reveal defect, not the full Visual Editor acceptance scope
finding: When the same public canvas was decorated again, or its SANCI treatment was disabled, IntersectionObserver was disconnected while pending sanci-await-view opacity classes could remain on the Page Model DOM. The CSS makes these pending elements transparent, so an offscreen section could remain invisible after re-render/disable.

changes: Clear stale sanci-await-view and sanci-in-view classes after disconnecting the old observer, before applying the new decoration or returning disabled.
Bump the showcase and Page Renderer cache keys so the live browser requests the corrected module.
Add a regression contract that simulates offscreen pending state, an observer intersection, same-canvas re-render, and disable cleanup.
implementation.save_publish: No Page Model content, Save, Publish, production D1 data, or R2 state was modified.
